title: PriceCatcher: Transactional Records
description: The table below provides a preview of the full dataset, which contains over a million price records per month. We recommend that you download and work with the data in your preferred coding environment - Microsoft Excel will likely be insufficient due to the size of the dataset. This data should be used in conjuction with the Item Lookup and Premise Lookup tables.

fields.name: premise_code
fields.title: Premise Code
fields.description: [Categorical] Integer representing the premise, to be mapped using the [Premise Lookup Table](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/lookup_premise). The lookup table will give you the premise name, address, district, and state.

fields.name: item_code
fields.title: Item Code
fields.description: [Categorical] Integer representing the item, to be mapped using the [Item Lookup Table](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/lookup_item). The lookup table will give you the item name, unit of measurement, and categorisation.

methodology: Prices are collected and verified by groundstaff on a daily basis, with over 2 million prices collected every month.
caveat: This data is collected for the purpose of price surveillance, and is excellent for high-frequency analysis of specific items in specific locations. Inflation surveillance requires a different approach, in particular to ensure proper representativeness. Inflation analysis should be conducted using DOSM's CPI data. Therefore, PriceCatcher data should be used as a complement rather than a replacement to CPI data.
